{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies contrib/devtools/shell-win64-cross.nix and CI workflow configuration files.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Aligns Nix Windows cross-compilation with Guix release POSIX thread models and fixes CI container logging. Commit 6854ead11c notes that selecting POSIX through the Nixpkgs threads hook ensures GCC and target libraries agree instead of defaulting to MCF."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Updates documentation regarding private broadcast limitations and updates man pages and release notes.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Clarifies private transaction broadcast privacy claims and marks the feature as experimental. This corrects documentation that previously overstated origin concealment capabilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches torcontrol and netgroup paths, but the backport only scopes documentation and warnings rather than altering P2P protocol or networking behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter P2P network behavior or message handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/rpc/ files to adjust OpenRPC argument fallback schemas.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.2,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes OpenRPC schema metadata defaults for omitted arguments. Commit 7a0964a252 explains that getdeploymentinfo and sighashtype fallbacks were non-literal resolution hints rather than literal default values, reclassifying them as DefaultHint."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes follow area-specific wallet and tor functional tests rather than framework or testing harness machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify core test runner or test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches contrib/devtools and contrib/guix, but these are build and release configurations rather than standalone user or operator tools.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify developer or operator CLI tools."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only minor incidental diff in src/init.cpp without changes to core shared utilities, logging, or serialization primitives.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change utility infrastructure or shared libraries."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes descriptor lookup hashing in src/wallet/walletutil.* and src/script/descriptor.*.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Caches canonical descriptor string hashes to speed up HasWalletDescriptor lookups. Commit 7fdb8584da notes that canonical string comparison was previously slow because it recomputed the canonical string for each check."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
